_comment: English for admin-surfaced server messages (tasks 4.1, 4.2, and the 3.5 wire-value guard). Keyed by the exact Chinese literal currently hard-coded in the admin controllers, the Admin/Staff middleware and the Admin request validators. Values are Laravel translation keys, passed to __(): the key resolves to itself in en-US, and an entry is appended to zh-CN.json (key => original Chinese) so the message stays correct if locale ever resolves to Chinese. Keys that already exist in the catalogs are reused without editing them — see _reuse_existing_note. Admin-only by construction: app/Http/Middleware/User.php and the Client/User/Passport controllers are absent, because the end-user theme stays Chinese.
_not_translated_note: These Chinese literals appear in the admin path but are NOT display text. They are wire or logic values whose other side is not in scope, so translating them would break behavior. admin-i18n/lib/wire-check.mjs reports them and server-messages.mjs refuses to rewrite them.

_not_translated.模糊: A filter-condition token: the admin bundle sends condition=模糊, Admin/UserFetch and Admin/OrderFetch validate it with in:...,模糊,..., and the controller maps it to SQL like. Bundle side is a wire value excluded from the rewriter, so changing only this side breaks user and order filtering. Not rendered to the operator.
_not_translated.请求失败: app/Services/TelegramService.php:117 — internal Telegram bot error text, surfaced only in bot replies, never in the admin UI. Out of scope.
_not_translated.金额: CouponController:106 and GiftcardController:89 CSV export column value.
_not_translated.不限制: CouponController:110/112 and GiftcardController:93 CSV export cell values, not dashboard DOM text.
_not_translated.长期有效: UserController:188 and :270 CSV export values, and the same text is produced by the out-of-scope ClientController.
_not_translated.无订阅: UserController:196 CSV export default plan name; the identical Chinese label also lives in the admin bundle, so it must move with the bundle pass and not half here.
_not_translated.名称,类型,金额或比例,开始时间,结束时间,可用次数,可用于订阅,券码,生成时间: CSV export header row (double-quoted, interpolating). Operator-downloaded file content, not dashboard DOM text, so it is outside the spec surface; left Chinese rather than half-migrated with the value columns above.
_not_translated.名称,类型,数值,开始时间,结束时间,可用次数,礼品卡卡密,生成时间\\r\\n: CSV export header row (double-quoted, interpolating). Operator-downloaded file content, not dashboard DOM text, so it is outside the spec surface; left Chinese rather than half-migrated with the value columns above.
_not_translated.邮箱,余额,推广佣金,总流量,设备数限制,剩余流量,套餐到期时间,订阅计划,订阅: CSV export header row (double-quoted, interpolating). Operator-downloaded file content, not dashboard DOM text, so it is outside the spec surface; left Chinese rather than half-migrated with the value columns above.
_not_translated.账号,密码,过期时间,UUID,创建时间,订阅地址\\r\\n: CSV export header row (double-quoted, interpolating). Operator-downloaded file content, not dashboard DOM text, so it is outside the spec surface; left Chinese rather than half-migrated with the value columns above.

_csv_export_note: CouponController::generate and GiftcardController::export write CSV files whose Chinese column values are operator downloads, not dashboard DOM text. The spec's scope is the admin dashboard surface, so these are intentionally left Chinese here and recorded as a follow-up in the QA checklist rather than half-changed.
_reuse_existing_note: The following entries point at keys that already exist in the catalogs with a slightly different Chinese source on the zh side (参数有误 -> "Invalid parameter" whose zh value is 参数错误; 知识不存在 -> "Article does not exist" whose zh value is 文章不存在; 邮箱已存在于系统中 -> "Email already exists" whose zh value is 邮箱已在系统中存在). Those catalog entries are NOT edited, because user-facing code shares them; the English output is identical and the Chinese-mode wording shifts to a synonym.
